stem: A pump alarm appears. Tank level is normal, no visible leak is present, and the assigned zone has no flow. Which maintenance note is strongest?
choices: Pump P-12 alarmed at 14:10; tank level normal; no visible leak; Zone 3 no flow; operator checks complete; task affected; maintenance notified
Probably a bad motor; replace it
I reset it several times but did not record when
rationale: A useful escalation separates observable facts, permitted checks, time, impact, and notification from unsupported diagnosis.
